name: Koi Shiyo?
source:
The government took drastic measures to combat the falling birth rate and created Kukuri Gakuen, nicknamed 'Renai Gakuen', as a model case to promote love between students. Yuuki's parents did not outwardly show their love towards each other, so he was never interested in love. However, he was suddenly chosen to attend 'Renai Gakuen' despite his wishes.

In this school, students receive bracelets, called "rings", which they must exchange with another student they want to date.

Their exchange is like a confession and the evidence of shared love.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/04/01/april-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
政府采取了果断措施来应对出生率下降的问题，创建了一所名为括学院、绰号“恋爱学院”的学校，作为促进学生恋爱的示范案例。优树的父母从不外露对彼此的爱，因此他对恋爱毫无兴趣。然而，尽管并非他所愿，他突然被选中就读“恋爱学院”。

在这所学校里，学生们会收到被称为“戒指”的手环，必须将其与想要交往的另一名学生交换。

这种交换就像是告白，也是相爱的证明。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/04/01/april-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
